_comment: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR NAMES, IDS, TEAM AND VERSION OF EVERY APP.
Edit this file, then run `python3 tool/app_config.py apply`.
Gradle reads it directly; Xcode reads the generated code/apple/Config/App.xcconfig.
`python3 tool/app_config.py check` fails on drift; the Android and Xcode builds run it.

version._comment: name is what users see; build must grow with every store upload. Android versionCode = build * 10 + versionCodeOffset.

_comment: Both apps need the same applicationId (and signing key), or the Wear Data Layer will not connect them.
They are one Play app, so each bundle needs its own versionCode: versionCodeOffset (0-9) keeps them apart.
